newsitem.title: POLAND: PPAB PLANS NO NEW ISSUES.
newsitem.headline: PPAB PLANS NO NEW ISSUES.

text.p: The First Polish-American Bank (PPABank) plans no new share issues in the near future, its president said on Thursday.
"The bank will not be raising capital through new share issues in the near future," Marek Kulczycki told a news conference after the bank's shareholders' meeting.
Kulczycki also said that the bank expected to meet or slightly exceed its earlier announced net profit target of 12.4 million zlotys.
"The results so far allow to say authoritatively that the 1997 profit target will be met. After the first five months we are even slightly ahead of plan," he said.
